extensionName.message: Thundy AV – Email Scanner for Thunderbird
extensionName.description: Name of the add-on as shown in the add-on manager and on the store listing.

extensionDescription.message: Optional, opt-in scanner for email attachments and links. Nothing leaves your computer without your explicit consent.
extensionDescription.description: Short description of the add-on (max. 132 characters).

actionTitle.message: Thundy AV – scan status for this message
actionTitle.description: Tooltip of the message display action button.

bannerTitleOptIn.message: Thundy AV: real-time scanning is not enabled for this message.

bannerNoteOptIn.message: Scanning transmits data to external analysis services, but only if you enabled it in the add-on settings and only after you give your consent. See the add-on options.

bannerConsentMissing.message: External analysis is disabled in the options – nothing was transmitted.

bannerSenderOptIn.message: This sender is now scanned automatically.

menuScanMessageLinks.message: Scan all links of this message

notificationNoLinks.message: No links found in this message.

bannerPermissionDeniedHint.message: The host permission for the analysis service is missing. Please grant it in the add-on options.

errorHostPermissionMissing.message: Host permission for the analysis service is missing. Please grant it in the add-on options.

errorTierUploadBlocked.message: Uploading attachments is disabled in the privacy tier "Strict". Switch to "Balanced" or "Maximum" in the add-on options.

errorTierUrlScanBlocked.message: Submitting URLs is only allowed in the privacy tier "Maximum". Change the tier in the add-on options.

notificationInjectionFailed.message: The banner could not be inserted into the message view. Please report this with your Thunderbird version.

bannerTierBlocked.message: This action is not allowed by the current privacy tier. See the add-on options.

bannerAuthNone.message: No SPF/DKIM/DMARC result in the headers

bannerReplyToMismatch.message: Reply-To points to a different domain

bannerGateNote.message: Links in this message are only handed to the browser after a check.

gateChecking.message: Thundy AV is checking this link …

gateBlocked.message: Link blocked: the check found a high risk.

gateWarning.message: Link checked: noticeable – verify target and sender.

gateUnknown.message: Link checked: no external source available, local assessment only.

gateConfirmOverride.message: You are about to open a link that was rated as risky. This decision is written to the Thundy AV audit log. Continue?

gateReportSent.message: Report to the administrator has been prepared.

gateReportFailed.message: The report could not be created (no administrator contact configured?).

gateLoading.message: Link check is not available in this message view.

notificationGateActive.message: Link gate: links in this message are checked before opening.

notificationReportStarted.message: Report for $URL$ prepared for the administrator.

notificationReportNoContact.message: No administrator contact configured. Please add it in the add-on options.

notificationReportComposeFailed.message: The compose window could not be opened. The report text is available in the add-on options.
